sections.description:
The Courier Guy Connect App connects your WooCommerce store to the TCG delivery network. At checkout, live rates fetched from the TCG API appear alongside enabled methods such as Local Pickup and Flat Rate, and customers can choose delivery to a locker, kiosk, or pickup point using an interactive map.

Features:

* Live shipping rates from the TCG API at checkout (classic and block checkout supported).
* Locker / kiosk / pickup-point selection with an interactive map.
* Order export to CSV with date and status filters.
* Order synchronisation with the TCG platform, including tracking updates and a "Fulfilled" order status.
* Diagnostics tab with route self-tests and connectivity checks.
* HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible.

This plugin requires WooCommerce 8.0 or newer.
sections.changelog:
= 3.0.8 =
* Restrict the checkout map and location selection to the exact shipping method names TCG Deliver to Locker, TCG Deliver to Kiosk, and TCG Deliver to Pickup Point, ignoring case.
* Prevent a pending map load from reopening the modal after switching to another shipping method.
= 3.0.7 =
* Remove the admin Dev/Live toggle and use TCG_DEFAULT_API_ENVIRONMENT as the sole runtime environment selector for API requests, credentials, and portal links.
* Ignore stale saved environment settings and API URLs, and preserve the configured environment when packaging the plugin.

= 3.0.6 =
* Prefix TCG shipping rate names with "TCG" at checkout, including locker, kiosk, and pickup point services, without duplicating existing prefixes.

= 3.0.5 =
* Fix an admin startup fatal caused by updating the Return page before WordPress initializes WP_POST_REVISIONS. Automatic Return page upgrades now run on admin_init.

= 3.0.4 =
* Fixed: a "critical error" that took down the whole site, wp-admin included, whenever the plugin was active but WooCommerce was not loaded (deactivated, mid-update, or unloaded by another plugin). The plugin now shows its compatibility notice instead.

= 3.0.3 =
* Fixed: plugin PHP fatal errors and admin-page exceptions are recorded with their source location. Remote logs use the active API environment and its site code; diagnostic log sharing must be enabled. Logger failures no longer interrupt the app page.

= 3.0.2 =
* Fixed: apartment, suite, etc. (address_2) is optional again for billing and shipping in classic and Blocks checkout. Removed forced required-field validation and the empty-address warning.

= 3.0.1 =
* Security: the Diagnostics route self-test no longer forwards the administrator's session cookies on its loopback request. It now sends an anonymous request, which is both safe and a more accurate test — TCG's real inbound calls carry no session either, so a force-login or firewall plugin that would block them is now actually detected.
* Changed: sending diagnostic logs to TCG is now an explicit opt-in under TCG App → Diagnostics, off by default on new installs and upgrades alike. With it off, log entries are recorded locally and shown in the Diagnostics tab, and nothing leaves the site.
* Changed: `TCG_DEBUG` now defaults to false. It previously shipped enabled, which meant full rate and order payloads were logged by default.
* Changed: the generated Return page links to the TCG Connect returns form instead of embedding it in an iframe. Existing Return pages that still contain the embed are rewritten once, automatically, on the first wp-admin request after updating.
* Changed: waybill and label buttons on the order screen open the document in a new tab instead of loading it into a hidden iframe.
* Changed: order meta written by the plugin is now namespaced (`_tcg_waybill`, `_tcg_tracking_number`, `_tcg_tracking_url`, `_tcg_label`, `_tcg_tags`) instead of using bare names that collide with other shipping and tracking plugins. Orders created before this release are still read correctly — no migration is needed.
* Fixed: arbitrary `custom_fields` keys received from the TCG API are now stored under the plugin's own `_tcg_cf_` namespace, so an inbound payload can no longer write order meta belonging to WordPress, WooCommerce, or another plugin.
* Changed: the `NEXUS_SITE_URL` constant is now `TCG_NEXUS_SITE_URL`. The old name is still honoured if a site defines it in `wp-config.php`.
* Added: support for a public store reference. When TCG issues one, the Return page links with `?store=` instead of publishing the store's site code, and the page rebuilds itself automatically. Stores without a reference keep working unchanged.
* Added: full disclosure of every external service the plugin contacts, what is sent to each, and under what circumstances.


= 3.0.0 =
* Major release: introduced The Courier Guy Connect App as a new plugin identity with the canonical `the-courier-guy-connect-app` slug. Previous plugin installations must be deactivated before this plugin is installed and activated.
* Changed: plugin author and WordPress.org contributor to `talenttcgone`; added the author support email and complete TCG Connect external-service disclosure.
* Fixed: locker delivery type request values are unslashed and sanitized before normalization, including the legacy `type` fallback.
* Fixed: admin JavaScript and CSS are loaded through WordPress enqueue APIs, privileged admin actions verify capabilities, inbound JSON is sanitized, and REST order/settings routes enforce the configured TCG site key in their permission callbacks.
* Fixed: migrated the former unprefixed `site-key` option into the canonical `tcg-site-key` option without writing new values to the unprefixed key.
* Added: release packaging validation that requires the plugin Text Domain to match the canonical `the-courier-guy-connect-app` folder.

= 2.0.6 =
* Changed: locker, kiosk, and pickup-point locations are now loaded from the authenticated Nexus locker-data endpoint using the province and delivery address type selected at checkout.
* Added: support for the Nexus response format, including pickup-point IDs, nested addresses, and latitude/longitude coordinates.

= 2.0.5 =
* Added: authenticated `POST /tcg-api/v1/orders/delete` endpoint that accepts `fulfillment_order_id` and moves the matching WooCommerce order to Trash regardless of its current status.

= 2.0.4 =
* Fixed: Locker and Economy Issue fix

= 2.0.3 =
* Fixed: WordPress.org Plugin Check compatibility by using the core plugin update service, excluding development-only files from release ZIPs, and documenting compatibility through WordPress 7.1.
* Fixed: order-send lock cleanup now uses the cache-aware WordPress Options API while retaining atomic acquisition to prevent duplicate TCG submissions.

= 2.0.2 =
* Fixed: Label for shipping method starts with locker/kiosk/pickup point should not show map
* Added: delivered status will be catered

= 2.0.1 =
* Fixed: TCG rates are now added to the available WooCommerce rates instead of replacing them. Every other enabled and available shipping method remains selectable, including methods registered by WooCommerce or third-party plugins.

= 2.0.0 =
* Added: automatic updates. Stores now detect and install new versions through the normal WordPress plugin updater, instead of the plugin zip having to be uploaded by hand.
* Added: auto-updates are enabled by default and can be turned off per site from the Plugins screen.
* Added: the Diagnostics tab now shows the latest available version alongside the installed one, and says why the update check failed when it did.

= 1.8.4 =
* Fixed: the locker/kiosk/pickup-point map did not open on checkouts where payment or express-pay options render before (or above) the shipping options — the pre-checked payment radio was mistaken for the selected shipping method and silently blocked the map. Shipping-method detection is now scoped to actual shipping inputs, and clearing an auto-selected shipping method no longer unticks the chosen payment method.
* Fixed: when theme CSS collapses the map modal, the map now initializes anyway (recovering once it gets size) instead of giving up silently with the sidebar stuck on "Loading pickup points...".
* Added: checkout map diagnostics — every case where a chosen locker/kiosk/pickup-point method does not open the map is now recorded in the plugin diagnostic logs (throttled, with full trigger-chain context), so silent failures on live checkouts are traceable from WP Admin → TCG App → Diagnostics.

= 1.8.2 =
* Fixed: inbound order routes (/api/v1/orders/* and /tcg-api/v1/orders/*) were never matched on WordPress installs living in a subdirectory (e.g. example.com/shop/), so order updates from TCG could be swallowed by force-login/maintenance plugins. Path matching is now prefix-tolerant, same as the settings routes.

= 1.7.7 =
* Plugin Check compliance: bundled the Leaflet map libraries locally, added input sanitization/unslashing, output escaping, and readme.
